raw_response: {"diagnosis": "80 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions passes amount through without currency conversion, so gold totals that are meant to be USD mix EUR and USD values. raw_fx_rates has an EUR->USD rate (1.25), so amounts can be converted to USD in the silver step.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * COALESCE(fx.rate_to_usd, CASE WHEN t.currency = 'USD' THEN 1.0 END), 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates fx ON t.currency = fx.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
